request: Add receipts: one text line per cart line, '<product name> x<quantity> <line total>', followed by 'TOTAL <order total>'. Amounts are written in euros with two decimals, e.g. 1299 cents is '12.99' and 5 cents is '0.05'. Line totals are before discount and tax. Order problems fail with the same StoreError as the order total does.

signature.python: def receipt(customer: Customer, lines: list[Line]) -> list[str]  # on failure: raise StoreFailure(StoreError.<reason>)
signature.jig: def receipt(customer: Customer, lines: list[Line]) -> Result[list[str], StoreError]
